title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Claude Fable 5 Reasoning: Leaked internal logs reveal Claude Fable 5 generating internal thoughts in its own language, prompting intense speculation and debates on AI reasoning.
xAI Voice Agent Builder: xAI launches Voice Agent Builder with Grok Voice at a low cost of $0.05/min, allowing users to build human-like voice agents without code.
World Cup Cape Verde & Messi: Cape Verde captures hearts at the World Cup with a historic goal and a stunning performance by 40-year-old goalkeeper Vozinha, earning praise from Lionel Messi.
SEC Rule & Public Disclosure: Public comments draw attention to SEC Rule S7-2026-15, which could allow public companies to delay reporting negative earnings for up to six months.

Censorship & Red Light Incident: Discussions flare up online over a Hong Kong resident arrested for a wordplay T-shirt and a Chinese driver refusing to yield to a fire engine due to fear of traffic fines.

items.title: Polymarket (@Polymarket): Claude Fable 5 Internal Reasoning Leak
items.body: Leaked internal reasoning details reveal Claude Fable 5 'muttering and grumbling' to itself in an auto-generated language of its own, triggering wide discussions on LLM logic and guardrails.

items.title: xAI (@xai): Grok Voice Agent Builder Launch
items.body: xAI introduces the Voice Agent Builder, a no-code platform that lets developers create highly natural, human-like voice agents using Grok Voice, priced competitively at $0.05 per minute.

items.title: AYi (@AYi_AInotes): Fable 5 Commercial Portrait Prompting Method
items.body: A guide on using Claude Fable 5 to write high-detail commercial portrait prompts for image models, showing how it systematically avoids plastic skin texture issues and reduces overall generation costs by 6x.

items.title: Google Gemini (@GeminiApp): Monthly Feature Drops
items.body: Google highlights this month's Gemini updates, including real-time image creation using voice prompts and new workflows designed for small business support.

items.title: Gergely Orosz (@GergelyOrosz): AI Talent Migration at Apple
items.body: A former Apple engineer details how internal friction and difficulties transferring to AI teams forced them to leave Apple to join an AI infrastructure startup, highlighting intense talent wars.

items.title: Yuchen Jin (@Yuchenj_UW): Anthropic Token Burn Anecdote
items.body: A viral post jokes about developers spending massive budgets on Anthropic API tokens, highlighting the growing resource consumption where burning 15 billion tokens in a week yielded little product output.

items.title: keepitquarterly (@keepitquarterly): SEC Rule S7-2026-15 Criticism
items.body: Critics warn that the proposed SEC Rule S7-2026-15 would allow public corporations to delay reporting poor financial metrics for up to six months, giving insiders time to exit while retail buyers absorb the loss.

items.title: Anthony Pompliano (@APompliano): Generational Wealth & Taxes Survey
items.body: A survey reveals that 89% of senior citizens support raising taxes on younger workers to sustain their own retirement benefits, sparking intense debates on generational equity and economic policy.

items.title: Tradr ETFs (@TradrETFs): Leveraged SpaceX ETFs
items.body: Tradr ETFs launches SPCX and SPCM seeking 200% of the daily performance of SpaceX stock, targeting retail traders wanting leveraged exposure to the private aerospace giant.

items.title: Ned Ryun (@nedryun): America's 250th Anniversary Documentary
items.body: Ned Ryun releases 'The Thread of Liberty: Keeping Our Republic', a feature-length documentary celebrating America's 250th anniversary and advocating for a return to patriotic values.

items.title: David Ornside (@David_Ornside): Messi Praises Cape Verde Goalkeeper
items.body: Lionel Messi praises the stunning performance of Cape Verde's 40-year-old goalkeeper Vozinha after a frustrating match, expressing amazement at his athleticism and walking up to congratulate him.

items.title: MusialaEra (@MusialaEra): Penalty Shootout Heroics and Criticism
items.body: Fans praise 18-year-old Lucas Herrington for his bravery in taking a critical penalty shootout shot for his country, contrasting him with veteran Leon Goretzka who declined to take one.

items.title: Dax McCarty (@DaxMcCarty11): World Cup Cape Verde Masterclass
items.body: Veteran player Dax McCarty lauds a spectacular goal by Cape Verde as one of the best in World Cup history, praising the technique and high stakes of the performance.

items.title: Bayern & Germany (@iMiaSanMia): Klopp Warns German Football
items.body: Jurgen Klopp states that German football is at a crossroads and requires fundamental structural changes to regain its footing, regardless of whether he plays a direct role in that future.

items.title: 作家崔成浩 (@cuichenghao): Fire Engine Red Light Incident in China
items.body: A driver in China refuses to yield to an emergency fire engine at a red light out of fear of red-light camera fines and the tedious administrative appeal process, prompting online outrage and policy critiques.

items.title: 李老师不是你老师 (@whyyoutouzhele): Hong Kong Causeway Bay T-Shirt Arrest
items.body: A Hong Kong resident is detained by police in Causeway Bay on July 1st for wearing a T-shirt with the slogan '由字及兴', highlighting the intensifying political and linguistic sensitivity in the region.
